commands.observed: 4 tests passed against a temporary PostgreSQL database after all 6 migrations were applied.
22 tests passed, including operator triage/replay service behavior and denial auditing.

verified_controls: Triage aggregates workflow, signal, effect, node-run, generation, render and Outbox projections.
Every triage collection is bounded to 100 rows.
Replay accepts only persisted PROCESSING or FAILED signals and revalidates the stored payload.
Replay writes an ALLOWED audit row before the deterministic replay Outbox row in one transaction.
Consumed, pending and invalid signals are rejected with stable conflict codes.
Non-operator triage is denied and audited.
limitations: oldestQueueAgeMs is pending/processing Outbox age, not a live Redis queue-age metric.
Live BullMQ publication and Redis queue metrics require authenticated Redis access.
